blocks.body: Sewer rodding clears a blocked main line with a long, flexible steel cable fed through a cleanout access point. A cutting head on the end breaks through roots, grease, and debris and pushes the blockage toward the street connection, restoring flow through the pipe. It's the standard first fix for a clogged or backed-up sewer line. For most homes, it's the only fix needed.

img.alt: Diagram showing a rodding cable fed through a cleanout access point into the main sewer line, with a cutting head clearing the blockage toward the street connection

blocks.h2: Main Line Clog Signs in Hinsdale Homes
blocks.intro: These point past a single fixture:

tiles.h3: The Floor Drain Is the First to Back Up
tiles.body: It's the lowest opening, so a main line clog shows there first.
When all the fixtures slow down, the shared line is blocked.
Air trapped behind the clog bubbles up through other drains.
Roots in old clay tend to block the line around the same time each year.

blocks.h2: What Blocks Main Lines in Hinsdale
blocks.intro: Hinsdale's mix of century-old and brand-new homes means the cause varies by block.

items.body: In older neighborhoods, roots grow through clay joints and form dense mats.
Original cast iron inside older homes builds rust scale that snags paper.
Now and then we find sand or debris left in a line after a teardown and rebuild.
If roots return fast, [hydro jetting](/hinsdale/hydro-jetting) or a [sewer repair](/hinsdale/sewer-repair) lasts longer.

blocks.intro: We open the line, then explain what we found.

The line is cleared to the main and checked on camera.

blocks.h2: Sewer Rodding Questions From Hinsdale Homeowners

items.q: How do I know the clog is in the main line?
items.preview: The floor drain or several fixtures are involved.
items.answer: If the basement floor drain backs up, or several fixtures on different floors are slow, the blockage is in the main line.

items.q: How often should an older Hinsdale home be rodded?
items.preview: About once a year if roots have been a problem.
items.answer: About once a year, ideally in late winter or early spring, if roots have blocked the line before.

items.q: Can rodding damage an old clay pipe?
items.preview: Not with the right equipment. We check it on camera.
items.answer: Not when it's done with the right cutting head. If the pipe is already cracked or broken, the camera will show it and we'll explain the options.

items.q: What if my older home has no cleanout?
items.preview: We can go through a toilet or vent, or add one.
items.answer: We can usually reach the line through a toilet or a roof vent. Adding a cleanout makes every future visit easier and less invasive.

items.q: How much does sewer rodding cost in Hinsdale?
items.preview: It depends on access and the clog. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the cleanout is, how long the line is and what's blocking it. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we begin.
